svg.title: Snakes and ladders board of 205 days of GitHub contributions since May 2026; a mouse walks from the first day to today.
svg.text: Every day since May, as a board game
3,308 contributions across 205 days. Ladders climb from my busiest days; snakes slide from the quiet ones.
